Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (CLMS) using the sulfo-SDA cross-linker. While not a standard PTM enrichment like phosphorylation, it is a targeted structural proteomics assay. The 'mod_tpp' (Tandem Proteomics/Cross-linking) modifier is the closest fit for CLMS workflows. The study specifically investigates 'noncovalently associated peptides' (NAP) as artifacts in CLMS.

noncellular_sources: Human blood serum (20 μg aliquots, 1 μg/μL)
scope: Using only the monomeric protein band obtained from sodium dodecyl sulfate polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis allowed identified links to be validated
Cross-linked samples were separated using gel electrophoresis, with bands corresponding to monomeric HSA excised

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment specifically investigates 'noncovalently associated peptides' (NAPs) which mimic cross-links. Reanalysis requires a pipeline capable of distinguishing covalent cross-links from non-covalent associations, potentially using MS1 co-elution profiles as described in the text.
